hints.title: Sequential Word Concatenation
hints.text: Progressively concatenate words from the array in their original sequence.

hints.title: Prefix Matching and Early Termination
hints.text: If the accumulated concatenated string equals s exactly, return true. If its length exceeds s, return false.

hints.title: Complete Match Requirement
hints.text: Partial words cannot be used; s must equal the exact concatenation of the first k words for some k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear prefix accumulation with early stopping.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full concatenation of all words regardless of length does unnecessary work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Early stopping when accumulated length exceeds s keeps execution proportional to length of s.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should stop early when length exceeds target string.
